title: '(as an Envoy)' options are inconsistent in risk: most ('hear the whole of it, unasked', 'broker the hall a truce', 'offer him a face-saving trade', 'read his real terms, not his script') auto-succeed with no roll, but one early one at the Hunter's Camp ('turn your best charm on him') is a real DC roll and can fail — the only tell is the extra '(a gamble)' tag, easy to miss on a first read.
